# awacino_api_key (Data Source)

The calling API key: its sections and when it ends, so a pipeline can warn before its key expires. Keys themselves are created by a human admin in the Awacino app, never by Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "awacino_api_key" "this" {}

# Warn a pipeline 14 days before its key ends.
check "api_key_lifetime" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.awacino_api_key.this.expires_at == null ? true : timecmp(data.awacino_api_key.this.expires_at, timeadd(plantimestamp(), "336h")) > 0
    error_message = "The Awacino API key ends within 14 days - create a new one in the app (Company settings > Awacino API)."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `company_id` (String) The company the key belongs to.
- `created_at` (String) When the key was created (when the API reports it).
- `description` (String) The key's description.
- `expires_at` (String) When the key ends (when the API reports it).
- `id` (String) Key id (`awk_...`).
- `owner_kind` (String) `company` or `partner`.
- `scopes` (List of String) Scopes (`users:read`, `users:write`, `connections:read`, `connections:write`, `audit:read`).
- `sections` (Map of String) Per section (`users`, `connections`, `audit`): `none`, `read` or `write`.
